lead.zh: 给想读懂论文和技术报告的人：从模型怎么训练、怎么变小变快，到怎么判断一个评测结果可不可信；沿途七张经典论文卡示范怎么读一篇具体论文。
lead.en: For people who want to read papers and tech reports: how models are trained, how they get smaller and faster, and when an eval result is trustworthy — with seven classic paper cards showing how to read a specific paper.

steps: 论文卡-Attention Is All You Need

zh: 把一份技术报告的训练章节拆成预训练/后训练两段，各说出关键变量
看到「刷新 SOTA」的说法，先查评测集发布时间和训练截止日期的关系
读模型卡时能指出许可证、评测口径和已知局限三处关键信息
对路线里的论文卡，各说出研究问题与核心证据位置，并说出至少一条「论文没有主张」的流行说法
en: Split a tech report's training section into pretraining and post-training, naming the key variables of each
On seeing a "new SOTA" claim, first check the benchmark's release date against the model's training cutoff
When reading a model card, point out the license, the eval setup, and the stated limitations
For each paper card on this route, state its research question and where the core evidence sits, and name at least one popular claim the paper never makes
